title: Parent-teacher communication app
summary: Better messaging between schools and parents.
whyItFails: Schools buy slowly. Procurement is bureaucratic. Bundled by school systems. Learning management systems include messaging. Low budgets. Schools have little money for new tools.
whatWouldChange: Selling district-wide with compliance and integration features.

attempts.notes: Free for teachers; launched its first paid product, a family subscription, in 2018. Criticised over student behaviour data.

reasons.detail: Schools buy slowly: Procurement is bureaucratic.
Bundled by school systems: Learning management systems include messaging.
Low budgets: Schools have little money for new tools.
